title: 第19章 罗大翔的评价林默是鬼才第20章 结扎网红被骗婚
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
“同学们，我確实在这一场官司上没有展现出什么法律素养和答辩博弈。
但是!大家有没有想过，我展现的是更高层面的东西？”
更高层面的东西？
直播间5万人都歪了歪脑袋，似懂非懂。
林默笑了笑解释道：“大家仔细想想，我的这一场官司，是不是给全国被霸凌的学生打了个样？”
以后所有被欺负的学生都可以按照这个思路去维护自己的权益，
而不是纠结於那些法律条文，去论证什么故意伤害罪成立。
所以我说这是更高层面的东西，高到所有人被霸凌者都可以去利用！”
听完，大家愣了一下，然后恍然大悟！
很快就有观眾说道：“对啊，如果只是单纯的打官司，证明了王乐乐是被霸凌了，那只拯救了王乐乐一人。
记住我们101看书网
但是，林律师提出了一个新的理念，所有学生都可以模仿啊！”
“没错！说的太对了！”
“就是这个理！罗大翔老师也是这么表达的。”
“我去，这是传授思想绝学，授人以渔啊！”
林默特地解释的很详细，观眾们也都听懂了。
这时候，连线的榜一问道：“林律师，那你还有什么其他的好办法，防止被霸凌吗？”
好好好。
这饭硬是得餵到你们嘴巴里你们才肯吃是吧。
林默无奈，开口说道：

“其他方法还是有的，第一个，直接报警，不要说是校园霸凌，而是直接说被对方『恶意殴打』，这样警方就必须立案，14岁以上追究刑事责任，14岁以下追究治安责任，同时当著警察和老师的面，让对方家长出具安全保证书。”
“第二个办法，直接去教育局，找到分管扫黑除恶的科室，反映校园霸凌，教育局涉及的扫黑就是校园霸凌这个项目，到时候学校就会反过来找你，即使你没有背景也是主动的那一方。
这样还不行，就再去上一层，儘量往扫黑上面靠，一定会有人关注的，到时候学校领导都会受到压力，会积极处理的。”
接著，林默邪魅一笑，意味深长的说道：
“第三个办法，那就是利用对方的贪婪了，比如你那天身上正好带了2000元的生活费，然后正好又被他们校霸看上了。”
说到这个，直播间里全都是“懂！大家都懂”的评论。
连线的那位榜一大哥也都嘿嘿的笑了起来。
“林律师，您真是深谋远虑的鬼才啊。”榜一大哥夸讚道：“至少我从来没有见过你这样的律师。”
“对了，那万一校霸们知道了不上当怎么办？”
林默微微一笑：“我已经打开了大家的思路，难道各位就不会自己去发现抗爭的办法？有了从0到1，那后续的123就很简单了。”
“而且大数据时代大部分施暴者第一时间搜不到这个视频。”
“等他们刷到的时候，已经.....”
林默一说完，榜一大哥连连点头。
“懂了！”
有了这个思路，不只是抢劫罪名，还有很多罪名可以给这些校霸布局嘛。
这时候评论也是疯狂刷了起来。
“我只能说这一手太骚了....”
“这是正经律师能够想出来的办法？”
“我知道有一个称號很適合林律师，风骚律师！哈哈哈哈！”
“真的牛！”

“我都想试试了！我烦死我老板了！”
“克制啊！兄弟们，这...这是很好的行为！”
林默的话也被人剪辑了下来，发送到了网络上。
无数正饱受校园霸凌折磨的孩子们和家长们也听到了消息，都在上网关注这件事。
content_en:
"Students, I did not show any legal literacy or defense skills in this lawsuit.
But! Have you ever thought that what I am showing is something at a higher level? "
Something higher?
The 50,000 people in the live broadcast room all tilted their heads, seeming to understand.
Lin Mo smiled and explained: "Think carefully, does this lawsuit of mine set a precedent for bullied students across the country?"
In the future, all students who are bullied can follow this idea to protect their rights.
Instead of getting entangled in those legal provisions to prove the crime of intentional injury.
So I say this is something at a higher level, so high that everyone who is being bullied can take advantage of it! "
After listening, everyone was stunned for a moment, and then suddenly realized!
Soon some viewers said: "Yes, if it is just a simple lawsuit that proves that Wang Lele was bullied, it will only save Wang Lele.
Remember us 101 reading website
However, Attorney Lin proposed a new concept that all students can imitate! "
"That's right! That’s so right! "
"That's the truth! Teacher Luo Daxiang also expressed this. "
"Let me go, this is to teach people the unique knowledge of thought and teach people how to fish! "
Lin Mo explained it in detail, and the audience understood it.
At this time, the first person on the line asked: "Lawyer Lin, do you have any other good ways to prevent being bullied? "
OK OK.
This meal has to be fed into your mouths before you are willing to eat it, right?
Lin Mo was helpless and said:
"There are still other ways. The first one is to call the police directly. Don't say it is school bullying, but directly say that the other party was "maliciously beaten." In this way, the police must file a case. Those who are over 14 years old will be held criminally responsible, and those under 14 will be held public security responsibilities. At the same time, in front of the police and teachers, ask the other party's parents to issue a safety guarantee letter. "
"The second way is to go directly to the Education Bureau and find the department in charge of combating gangs and eradicating evil, and report school bullying. The Anti-Gangs project involved in the Education Bureau is the school bullying project. When the time comes, the school will come back to you. Even if you have no background, you will be the one who takes the initiative.
If this doesn't work, go to the next level and try your best to crack down on criminals. Someone will definitely pay attention. By then, the school leaders will be under pressure and will actively deal with it. "
Then, Lin Mo smiled evilly and said meaningfully:
"The third way is to take advantage of the other party's greed. For example, you happened to have 2,000 yuan of living expenses with you that day, and then you happened to be spotted by their school bully. "
When it comes to this, everyone in the live broadcast room is "Got it!" Everyone understands" comment.
The top guy on the line also laughed.
"Lawyer Lin, you are such a far-sighted genius. The first brother on the list praised: "At least I have never seen a lawyer like you." "
"By the way, what if the school bullies find out and don't fall for it? "
Lin Mo smiled slightly: "I have opened everyone's minds, won't you find ways to fight on your own? With the number from 0 to 1, the subsequent 123 is very simple. "
“And in the era of big data, most perpetrators cannot find this video immediately. "
"By the time they got there, they were already..."
As soon as Lin Mo finished speaking, the eldest brother nodded repeatedly.
"Got it! "
With this idea, not only the crime of robbery, but also many crimes can be laid out for these school bullies.
At this time, the comments started to go crazy.
"I can only say that this hand is too sexy..."
“Is this a solution that a serious lawyer can come up with? "
"I know there is a title that suits Lawyer Lin very well, Better Call Saul! Ha ha ha ha! "
“Really awesome! "
"I want to try it! I'm so annoyed with my boss! "
"Restrain! Guys, this...this is good behavior! "
Lin Mo's words were also cut offEdited it and sent it to the Internet.
Countless children and parents who are suffering from school bullying have also heard the news and are following the incident online.
